about.heading: About Sattori
intro: Sattori is a free service that automatically generates a recorded video just by uploading a Touhou Project replay file.
It was created with the hope that more people who play the original Touhou games will start publishing their playthrough videos.
The goal is to let anyone create a recorded video of a replay casually, without any tedious steps or video-editing knowledge, and easily upload it to video sites.
about.disclaimer: This service is an unofficial, fan-made project unaffiliated with the Touhou Project's development circles — Team Shanghai Alice, Shanghai Alice Reprise, and Tasogare Frontier — their representative ZUN, or any other individuals or organizations holding related rights. Please do not contact Team Shanghai Alice with inquiries about this service.

terms.heading: Terms of Service
intro: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") set out the conditions for using Sattori (the "Service"), an automatic Touhou Project replay recording service. By using the Service, you are deemed to have agreed to these Terms.
This English text is a translation provided for convenience. The original of these Terms is the Japanese version, and in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Japanese version prevails.

sections.heading: 1. Description of the Service
paragraphs: The Service automatically records a video based on a Touhou Project replay file (.rpy) uploaded by the user, and provides it as a video file.

The Service is an unofficial, fan-made project unaffiliated with the Touhou Project's development circles — Team Shanghai Alice, Shanghai Alice Reprise, and Tasogare Frontier — their representative ZUN, or any other individuals or organizations holding related rights.

sections.heading: 2. Handling of Data
paragraphs: Generated videos contain copyrighted material from the original Touhou Project games. If you re-upload a video to a video-sharing site or similar platform, you are responsible for complying with the Touhou Project's secondary-creation guidelines and the terms of service of each platform you use.

sections.heading: 3. Disclaimer
paragraphs: The operator does not warrant that the Service is free of factual or legal defects, including but not limited to recording failures, discrepancies between the recording and the original replay, data loss or delay, malfunctions, or security issues.
Except in cases of the operator's willful misconduct or gross negligence, the operator is not liable for any damage arising from the Service.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Rights to a replay file you upload remain with you.

Rights to any Touhou Project-related copyrighted material contained in a generated video remain with the respective rights holders. The operator does not claim any rights beyond providing the recording and conversion service.

sections.heading: 5. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: The operator may revise these Terms as necessary without individual notice to users. The revised Terms take effect once posted on this page.

sections.heading: 6. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any dispute arising in connection with the Service shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the court having jurisdiction over the operator's place of residence as the court of first instance.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
paragraphs: For inquiries about these Terms, please use the contact information listed on the "About" page.

uploadForm.dropzoneOwnPlayNotice: Please select a file that recorded your own play.
uploadForm.emailHint: A link to download the recorded video will be sent to this email address.
uploadForm.watermarkHintLine1: For a few seconds before the replay itself starts, the "TouhouSattori" logo is shown in the bottom-right corner of the video.
uploadForm.watermarkHintLine2: It is not shown while the replay is playing.
uploadForm.slowMotionHintLine1: The game is run at half speed while recording and restored to normal speed afterwards. This reduces frame drops and keeps busy scenes smooth.
uploadForm.slowMotionHintLine2: Recording takes roughly twice as long to finish.
uploadForm.slowMotionUnavailable: The recording servers are busy right now, so no server that supports slow-motion recording is available. Please try again later.
uploadForm.slowMotionUnsupportedGame: This title does not support slow-motion recording yet, so it is unavailable.
uploadForm.th10BugfixMarisaBOption: Record with the "bug Marisa" fix enabled
uploadForm.th10BugfixMarisaBHintLine1: Marisa B in Mountain of Faith has a known bug ("bug Marisa") where her shot power spikes abnormally for a while. Only enable this option if you fixed that bug with a fan-made patch while playing.
uploadForm.th10BugfixMarisaBHintLine2: Choosing a setting different from how the replay was actually played will make the recording diverge from the original playthrough.
uploadForm.th10BugfixMarisaBUnsupportedGame: This option is only available for Marisa B replays of Mountain of Faith.
uploadForm.th20NoticeTitle: About recording replays of this title
uploadForm.th20NoticeDesync: Fossilized Wonders is prone to replay desync (playback diverging from the run that was recorded), so the video may not match what the replay originally showed. This comes from the replay file and the game itself, so re-recording produces the same result. Also, when a desync happens during recording on TouhouSattori, the recording takes much longer to finish (up to about two hours). Note that players have reported that saving replays while playing with the community patch <0>thprac</0> applied avoids the desync.
uploadForm.th20NoticeFrameDrop: This title is demanding to render, and recording can drop frames during dense danmaku scenes.
uploadForm.th20NoticeNormalSpeed: Enabling "Prioritize quality with slow-motion recording" in the advanced settings should improve this to some extent.
uploadForm.termsAgreement: By continuing, you agree to the <0>Terms of Service</0>.

replayHelp.heading: Where Touhou Project games save replay files
replayHelp.intro: Where your replay file is saved depends on which title you played. Choose your title below.

installFolder.heading: {{first}} – {{last}}
installFolder.description1: A "replay" folder is created automatically right inside the folder where you installed {{title}}, and your replay files are saved there after you play.
installFolder.defaultLabel: If you used the default install location, it's saved here by default.
installFolder.virtualStoreLabel: However, on Windows 11 and many current systems, UAC virtualization is enabled by default, so it may actually be saved in this folder instead.
installFolder.steamLabel: If you bought it on Steam, it's saved here by default (you can also open it from your Steam library: right-click the game → Manage → Browse local files).

appData.heading: {{first}} onward
appData.description1: {{title}} stores data such as your scores and replay files in your %APPDATA% folder.
appData.pathLabel: By default, your replay files are saved here.

replayPreview.emptyPlaceholder: Please select a replay file first

magicLinkSent.heading: Please check your email
magicLinkSent.sentTo: We've sent a link to start the recording to <0>{{email}}</0>.
magicLinkSent.hint: Click the link in the email to start recording (it's valid for 24 hours). You can open it as many times as you like to check progress or download the video.
magicLinkSent.spamHint: If it hasn't arrived after a few minutes, please also check your spam folder.

jobProgress.retryHint: This is taking longer than usual. Please wait a bit longer.
jobProgress.desyncWarning: The in-game score at the end of recording didn't match the score recorded in the replay file. A replay desync may have occurred.
jobProgress.desyncWarningDetail: A replay desync is a phenomenon where the replay's playback diverges from what was originally recorded during gameplay. When it occurs, you may see hits in scenes that shouldn't have been hit, or the replay may end early. Please check the recorded video and make sure no desync has occurred. Note that this comes from the nature of the replay file and the game itself, so re-recording will produce the same result.
jobProgress.timeoutWarning: Recording was cut off after reaching the time limit without detecting the end of the replay. The final part of the replay may be missing from the video.
jobProgress.timeoutWarningDetail: Recording normally stops once the end of replay playback is detected, but this job reached the recording time limit before that could happen, so it was cut off partway through. Please check the recorded video to make sure the ending isn't missing. If it is, please try uploading the replay again.
jobProgress.slowMotionHint: Slow-motion recording is being used to prioritize quality, so this takes about twice as long as usual.
jobProgress.genericError: A problem occurred while recording. Please try again.
jobProgress.downloadExpiresAt: The video will be available for download until {{date}}
jobProgress.hint: Recording and conversion continue even if you close this page. You can come back to this page at any time to check the status.
jobProgress.pollError: Failed to fetch the status. Retrying…
